seo.title: Wellington homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Wellington.

page.heading: WELLINGTON - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger or medical emergency: 111. Nowhere to stay: Work and Income 0800 559 009; age 65 or older 0800 552 002.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: If you need somewhere to stay tonight, call Work and Income before paying for accommodation. DCM supports people who are rough sleeping or without shelter, while Whakamaru and the Compassion Soup Kitchen provide practical daytime help, meals, showers and referrals.
page.footer: Main sources: Work and Income, Ministry of Housing and Urban Development, DCM, Wellington City Mission, Te Aro Health Centre, Orange Sky, Kaibosh and the listed organisations.

entries.title: Work and Income emergency housing
entries.description: Government assessment for people who have nowhere to stay tonight or within the next seven days. Work and Income considers other options first, then may arrange transitional or emergency accommodation if the person qualifies and space is available.
entries.address: Phone service and Wellington service centres
entries.how_to_access: Call before booking or paying for a motel. People aged 65 or older can call 0800 552 002.

entries.title: DCM
entries.description: Specialist Wellington service for people who are rough sleeping, without shelter or at risk of homelessness. DCM assists with housing, benefits, identification, food, health connections and other practical needs.
entries.how_to_access: Walk in during morning hours or call the freephone number.

entries.title: Emergency and transitional housing assessment
entries.description: Work and Income is the official route for urgent emergency housing and referrals to funded transitional housing. Emergency housing is short-term and usually reviewed after seven nights.
entries.how_to_access: Call first. Same-day accommodation is not guaranteed.

entries.title: DCM housing support
entries.description: Housing-focused support for people sleeping rough or without shelter. Staff help people work toward emergency, transitional or long-term housing and navigate government services.

entries.title: Compassion Soup Kitchen
entries.description: Breakfast and a low-cost evening meal for people who need food. The service is listed by DCM and Kaibosh as a Wellington meal provider.
entries.how_to_access: Walk in. Confirm holiday hours before travelling.

entries.title: Whakamaru - Wellington City Mission
entries.description: Community hub with a café, social supermarket by appointment and support staff who can connect visitors with other services. Food support may require an appointment and identification.
entries.hours: Café Monday-Friday 7:30am-3:00pm and Saturday 8:00am-3:00pm; social supermarket by appointment
entries.how_to_access: Visit the hub or call 0800 245 0900. Ask how to access food support.

entries.title: Whakamaru community support
entries.description: Practical help, peer support and connections to housing, health and welfare services in an open community hub.
entries.hours: Monday-Friday and Saturday; check the current service timetable
entries.how_to_access: Walk in and speak with the community support team.

entries.title: Whakamaru showers and laundry
entries.description: Free shower, toilet and laundry facilities. Internal showers and laundry are staffed; external showers are available around the clock.
entries.hours: Internal showers Monday-Friday 9:00am-4:00pm and Saturday 9:00am-3:00pm; external showers 24 hours; laundry Monday-Friday 9:00am-4:00pm
entries.how_to_access: Walk in and ask staff to use the facilities.

entries.title: Orange Sky Wellington
entries.description: Free mobile laundry, shower and conversation service for anyone experiencing homelessness or hardship. The van operates alongside community partners at different locations.
entries.how_to_access: Check the live Wellington schedule before travelling.

entries.title: Te Aro Health Centre
entries.description: Primary health care focused on people experiencing homelessness and other barriers to care. An outreach clinic also operates from DCM.
entries.hours: Clinic Monday-Friday 9:00am-12:00pm and 1:00pm-4:30pm; DCM outreach Monday-Thursday 9:00am-12:00pm
entries.how_to_access: Call or attend the clinic. Ask about fees and enrolment before treatment where possible.

entries.title: Ora Toa medical centre at Whakamaru
entries.description: Primary medical care on the first floor of Whakamaru. Wellington City Mission also provides a limited free dental service delivered by Ora Toa dentists.
entries.how_to_access: Call for an appointment and ask about enrolment, fees and dental eligibility.

entries.title: Wellington City Libraries
entries.description: Public libraries provide internet access, computers, charging points and help finding information. Access rules and computer availability vary by branch.
entries.how_to_access: Choose a branch and check whether a library card is needed for computer use.

entries.title: Work and Income Wellington
entries.description: Government benefits, hardship assistance, housing costs, emergency housing assessment and employment support.
entries.how_to_access: Call or visit a service centre. Bring identification if available, but call even if documents are missing.

entries.title: Work and Income employment support
entries.description: Job-search assistance, training referrals and income support while looking for work. Support depends on eligibility and individual circumstances.
entries.how_to_access: Call or make an appointment at a Wellington service centre.

entries.title: Community Law Wellington and Hutt Valley
entries.description: Free initial legal help for people who cannot afford a lawyer. Services include housing, benefits, employment, debt and family matters, subject to capacity and eligibility.
entries.how_to_access: Check the current clinic timetable and call before visiting.

entries.title: DCM identification support
entries.description: DCM helps people obtain identification, access the correct benefit, deal with debt and open a bank account when these barriers affect housing and stability.
entries.how_to_access: Walk in or call and explain which documents are missing.

entries.title: Women's Refuge crisis line
entries.description: Confidential support and safe-housing referrals for women and children experiencing family violence. The national line connects callers with local refuge services.
entries.how_to_access: Call 0800 REFUGE. Call 111 if there is immediate danger.
